answer: Each agent identity must pin a unique 50 GB encrypted storage shard, checked by a random beacon that pings an unpredictable byte-range each epoch. First, the agent commits the shard hash on-chain. Second, the beacon demands proof within 10 minutes. Third, three established peers verify it and log it to a crystal-clear public ledger. Over a 90-day horizon, missed proofs freeze earnings. Forging 10,000 fakes means buying 500 terabytes for $12,000 and passing 10,000 spot-checks daily. Like a library where every book must appear on demand, empty shelves get caught fast.
